title: Psalms 121
paragraphs: ¹ I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? ² My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

³ He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. ⁴ Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. ⁵ The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand. ⁶ The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night. ⁷ The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. ⁸ The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
